purpose: Actual 3D scene renders using one committed camera lock; bounded fits and unresolved camera/geometry residuals are recorded separately from visual fidelity.

fit_solver.method: scipy.optimize.least_squares, bounded default trust-region-reflective method, soft_l1 loss, f_scale=0.025, max_nfev=5000
fit_solver.initial_camera: baseline_camera and rejected_initial in this view; yaw=atan2(target_y-location_y,target_x-location_x)
fit_solver.fixed_optics: 24 mm native EXIF focal length, 36 mm sensor long axis, level camera, zero roll
fit_solver.objective: Normalized projected-minus-annotated UV residuals with square-root point weights, plus (z-z_initial)*0.01 and shift_x*0.002, shift_y*0.002 soft terms; holdout landmarks excluded.
fit_solver.limitations: Five coplanar inferred stone/sink points, no independent holdouts; solution touches the y=9.1 m lower bound. Unknown optical shift, crop and correction preserve pose/geometry ambiguity. This records the original solve, not a new fit.
